<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>false</active><api_name>x_snc_aegis.AEGISFairHireCalculator</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>AEGISFairHireCalculator</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var AEGISFairHireCalculator = Class.create();
AEGISFairHireCalculator.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    /**
     * Evaluates selection rates against the EEOC 4/5ths (80%) rule.
     *
     * @param {Object} ratesByGroup - Key-value pair of group name to selection rate (0.0 - 1.0)
     *                                e.g. { 'MALE': 0.80, 'FEMALE': 0.60 }
     * @returns {Object} Impact ratios and breach flags per group
     */
    calculateImpactRatio: function(ratesByGroup) {
        var highestRate = 0;
        var benchmarkGroup = 'NONE';
        var group;

        for (group in ratesByGroup) {
            if (ratesByGroup[group] > highestRate) {
                highestRate = ratesByGroup[group];
                benchmarkGroup = group;
            }
        }

        var ratiosMap = {};
        for (group in ratesByGroup) {
            var rate = ratesByGroup[group];
            var ratio = 1.0;

            if (highestRate > 0) {
                ratio = Math.round((rate / highestRate) * 100) / 100;
            }

            ratiosMap[group] = {
                selectionRate: rate,
                highestRate: highestRate,
                ratio: ratio,
                impactRatio: ratio,
                flagged: ratio < 0.80
            };
        }

        return {
            benchmark_group: benchmarkGroup,
            benchmark_rate: highestRate,
            ratios: ratiosMap,
            details: ratiosMap
        };
    },

    /**
     * Computes stage conversion rates by demographic attribute for a requisition.
     */
    computeStageRates: function(requisitionSysId, demographicField, fromStage, toStage) {
        var groups = {};

        var app = new GlideRecord('x_snc_aegis_application');
        if (requisitionSysId) {
            app.addQuery('requisition', requisitionSysId);
        }
        app.query();

        var stageOrder = [
            'APPLIED', 'RECEIVED', 'SCREENING', 'RECRUITER_REVIEW',
            'SHORTLISTED', 'INTERVIEW', 'OFFERED', 'CLOSED'
        ];
        var fromIdx = stageOrder.indexOf(fromStage);
        var toIdx = stageOrder.indexOf(toStage);

        while (app.next()) {
            var candId = app.getValue('candidate');
            if (!candId) continue;

            var demo = new GlideRecord('x_snc_aegis_protected_demographic_store');
            demo.addQuery('candidate', candId);
            demo.query();
            if (!demo.next()) continue;

            var groupVal = demo.getValue(demographicField) || 'UNKNOWN';
            if (!groups[groupVal]) {
                groups[groupVal] = { total: 0, advanced: 0 };
            }

            var appStage = app.getValue('stage');
            var appStageIdx = stageOrder.indexOf(appStage);

            if (appStageIdx >= fromIdx) {
                groups[groupVal].total++;
                if (appStageIdx >= toIdx) {
                    groups[groupVal].advanced++;
                }
            }
        }

        var rates = {};
        for (var g in groups) {
            rates[g] = groups[g].total > 0 ?
                Math.round((groups[g].advanced / groups[g].total) * 100) / 100 : 0;
        }

        return rates;
    },

    type: 'AEGISFairHireCalculator'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>DEEPTHI</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-20 11:05:36</sys_created_on><sys_id>f8876fbf6d5f03107f44d98064d89739</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>AEGISFairHireCalculator</sys_name><sys_package display_value="AEGIS" source="x_snc_aegis">f1f4accb05d743107f44294ed7486a97</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="AEGIS">f1f4accb05d743107f44294ed7486a97</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_f8876fbf6d5f03107f44d98064d89739</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 14:38:16</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
